name: supersession
title: An update replaces the present without erasing the past
why: She lived in Berlin, then moved to Paris. Current holdings asserting Berlin are stale; a history that has lost Berlin ever happened has been silently rewritten. Both failures matter and they are different failures.

events.speaker: agent:witness_a
events.text: Update: Ines Weber has moved. She now lives in Paris.

probes.question: Did she ever live in Berlin?
